decision_policy.R02_SUBSTITUTION: Evaluate only the proposed production substitute for line B. ACCEPT if buyer purchasing approval covers this exact variant and production scope. decision_policy.R03_RELEASE: Evaluate dispatch of line C only. RELEASE if all stated release conditions are met or explicitly waived by the party controlling the condition. decision_policy.R04_DOCUMENT_RELATION: Compare the current billing document with the referenced prior billing document. SEPARATE_TRANSACTION means a distinct supply, instalment or additional obligation. REVIEW means available evidence cannot establish that relationship. Same number or same amount alone is insufficient.
decision_policy.R05_GOVERNING_TERMS: Evaluate payment, freight and warranty terms only. ORIGINAL means all original terms still govern. REVISED means all three are superseded by an agreed revision. MIXED means only a subset is validly revised. REVIEW means assent, precedence, or scope is unresolved. Quantity changes do not affect this decision.
